why: "3arada el sata7 kanet bayza w khallatny ash-taghal" is incoherent, not natural chat.

"beti2el" is wrong; Egyptian says "te2eela" (heavy).

"3ayshin fi mawqef sa3b" is a calque; Egyptians say "e7na fi maw2ef sa3b".
"ehna 3ayshin 3ala ad eh?" after asking a price is unclear, not idiomatic.
Clock time is "el sa3a 3ashara", not "el sa3a 3ashr".
Needs plural "3ashar atba2"; "3ashr taba2" is ungrammatical.

"araga3 3ad ma akoon 3ayesh gamb el souq" is nonsensical.

Incoherent directions; "3esh el-7ayah bel-7ob" is slogan-like, not chat.
